newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Number of NZ homes sold rises in March - REINZ.
newsitem.headline: Number of NZ homes sold rises in March - REINZ.

text.p: The total number of New Zealand homes sold in March was up on the number of sales for both January and February this year, the Real Estate Institute of New Zealand said on Thursday.
A total of 8,219 homes were reported sold by real estate agents in March, compared with 7,815 in January and 8,033 in February. In March 1996 the total was 10,056 homes.
REINZ said the median house price rose to NZ$164,000 in March, against $160,000 in February and $155,000 in March 1996.
In Auckland, the median house price was flat versus February at $235,000, and up $5,000 from $230,000 in March last year.
House sales in Auckland totalled 2,852 in March, up from 2,803 in February and down from 3,937 a year ago.

Real Estate Institute president Colin Brown advised against reading too much into the rise in the number of homes sold, as total sales in all but two regions (Hawke's Bay and Wellington) were still lower than for the same period last year.
"While it is encouraging to see growth in sales nationally, there are still areas within New Zealand that are recording fewer sales this month than earlier in the year," Brown said.
Both Wellington and Canterbury recorded steady sales growth, with 1,048 Wellington homes sold in March against 863 in January, and 1,279 Canterbury home sales against 1,148 in January.
"The increase in sales has not had an impact on the numbers of properties available for sale -- most districts report there are still good supplies of listings," Brown said.
A total of 669 sections were sold in March, with a median value of $68,000.
